description:
List image, video, 3D, chat, decision, STT and TTS models exposed by the public API.

Each model includes a human-readable description and capability tags. Use modes,
resolutions, aspect_ratios, duration/reference limits, output_formats and chat
context_window / max_output_tokens to choose a model; null fields mean unspecified, not unlimited.
Legacy image/video features may include Studio-only functionality; rely on
capabilities and modes for the public API.
generation_endpoint / estimate_endpoint identify the API operation. Use the
corresponding estimate_* tool to validate the exact request before generating.
Metadata is fetched live from the API; capabilities describe the API (MCP chat
is non-streaming, media uploads/transcription are limited to 10 MiB).

minimax-relight uses estimate_video_relight / create_video_relight;
minimax-camera-controls uses estimate_video_camera / create_video_camera;
lightx-recamera and lightx-relight use estimate_lightx_recamera / create_lightx_recamera
and estimate_lightx_relight / create_lightx_relight.
Models with ids starting higgsfield- are started with the dedicated Higgsfield tools,
not with create_video.
name: list_models
